lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's eight? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 8? Nope!

lines.text: For how many integers b are both roots of x squared plus b x plus twelve b equals zero integers?
lines.caption: For how many integers b are both roots of x² + bx + 12b = 0 integers?

lines.text: Call the roots r and s. Sum and product give r s plus twelve r plus twelve s equals zero.
lines.caption: Call the roots r and s. Sum and product give rs + 12r + 12s = 0.

lines.text: Add one hundred forty-four to both sides. That fills the grid!
lines.caption: Add 144 to both sides. That fills the grid!

lines.text: So r plus twelve, times s plus twelve, equals one hundred forty-four.
lines.caption: So (r+12)(s+12) = 144.

lines.text: Its factor pairs: eight positive, and eight negative!
lines.caption: Its factor pairs: 8 positive, and 8 negative!

lines.text: Every pair gives a different value of b. That's sixteen!
lines.caption: Every pair gives a different value of b. That's 16!

lines.text: Eight was the trap: it forgets the negatives.
lines.caption: 8 was the trap: it forgets the negatives.

lines.text: Did you get sixteen? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 16? Tell me below!
